name: Edge Case — Workflow Failure on Submission
goal: Verify bot handles submission workflow failure after retries and shows fallback message.
constraints: All steps valid, but UID generator workflow fails three times.

phases.description: User completes all steps and confirms preview.
UID generator workflow fails three times.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot says: 'I couldn't complete your submission right now. Please try again later or contact your location admin SPOC.' Conversation ends.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
